capture_resilience.root_cause: the probe wrote summary.json only after the whole selection; one 401 dropped the session and every later navigation timed out, and the scope adapter folded 'no per-entry observation' into failed
fixes: per-entry persistence: entries.jsonl append + atomic partial summary.json + SIGINT/SIGTERM persistence
bounded session recovery: intent 401 re-authenticates once and retries only that entry; recovery failure aborts as partial
partial semantics: unreached units are recorded neither as pass nor failure, so the next pass resumes them
